headline: European natural gas futures surge past €88 as Norway daily sales jump 20%
summary: Dutch TTF natural gas futures rose 4.4% to €88.22 per megawatt-hour as European gas storage levels remained below 70% ahead of winter. Norway reported a nearly 20% monthly increase in daily gas sales for October to 11 billion cubic meters.
why: Dutch TTF natural gas futures set energy pricing standards across Europe, influencing heating utility costs and heavy industry input prices.

impacts.name: Dutch TTF Natural Gas
impacts.why: Low inventory levels relative to seasonal averages raised winter supply security concerns.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Below-average regional storage levels drove aggressive utility hedging ahead of colder winter weather.
